prompts.hero: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: GoSendeet website hero photograph ONLY, no interface, no letters or logos. Generate a wide landscape 2.7:1 photograph matching the approved mock: a young Nigerian woman with long neat braids wearing an olive casual shirt using a smartphone with a small natural smile, placed at 65% of frame, waist-up; behind her at far right a softly defocused Nigerian courier in a deep green polo loading plain cardboard parcels into a white delivery van. Lagos contemporary residential street, natural daylight and authentic candid skin texture. Left 45% of image is dark forest charcoal defocused foliage / shadowed building with clear negative space to place white headline later. Keep woman's head and hands within middle vertical area for responsive crop. Calm, believable, warm. No text, no badges, no UI, no watermark. The image is background only.
prompts.handoff: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate ONLY a landscape 3:2 photograph for a Nigerian logistics website, no text or UI. Contemporary Lagos residential entrance, soft daylight, greenery, no brand logos, no watermark.
prompts.routes: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Website route-card asset, wide horizontal triptych 3:1 image, THREE EQUAL WIDTH rectangular photos side by side with NO gaps, no borders, no text. Panel CENTER everyday Lagos street with yellow danfo buses beneath elevated rail infrastructure in a dense neighbourhood, daylight.
